brief: A TypeScript SDK that issues Peruvian electronic payment documents to SUNAT. It should feel trustworthy, simple, warm and Peruvian — closer to a seal of acceptance than to a fintech dashboard.
criteria: Reads at 16 px, works in one colour, feels like a stamp of acceptance, and avoids the blue fintech and generic invoice-icon clichés.

concepts.name: Sello
concepts.idea: The seal of acceptance: a stepped T inside the double ring of a rubber stamp.
rationale: Turns the CDR into the brand: a document accepted
The double ring is a real stamp; the capsule stretches it to hold the name
Seal and wordmark work apart: they share the T's height, stem and curves

recommendation: Sello — the seal of acceptance. A double-ring stamp whose capsule carries the name, at home in a README, a browser tab or a printed receipt.
next_steps: Use the capsule in the README and docs
Keep the seal for the npm and GitHub avatar
Use clay sparingly for highlights and links
